description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - focus shield: a session gate for deep work. While a focus session runs, the agent listens omnidirectionally and only interrupts for a whitelist match on ASR transcript text (your own name or your custom keywords); every non-speech loudness spike is only logged to a silent timeline, never announced, and shown at the break summary. No sound classification exists on this platform, so doorbells, alarms and crying are honestly NOT claimed as recognised - they can only appear as unclassified noise entries to review at the break. All session data lives in session memory only and is wiped when the session is confirmed cleared or the agent closes.
name: focus-shield
